# ViraStack Guide (full)

> Interactive “modern web” guide on virastack.com. Teaches the stack layer by layer, demos Mask/Password, ends with an AI moment and a ViraStack ecosystem CTA. Not published as an npm library.

## URLs

- Landing: https://virastack.com/guide
- Play: https://virastack.com/guide/play
- Index: https://virastack.com/guide/llms.txt
- Ecosystem: https://virastack.com/llms.txt

## Audience & intent

Help frontend developers feel the path from raw HTML content → modern React architecture → utility CSS → typography → composed UI → theming → AI-assisted UI, then discover ViraStack Start / AI / Mask / Password.

## Steps

| # | Title | What the learner absorbs |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | Content is everything | Semantic content first; style comes after |
| 1 | The foundation | Modern baseline: React, TypeScript, Next.js, TanStack Start (not HTML/CSS alone) |
| 2 | CSS | Tailwind for layout/spacing instead of hand-written stylesheets |
| 3 | Typography | Typeface choice changes product tone |
| 4 | Components | shadcn/ui composition; live demos of `@virastack/mask` and `@virastack/password` |
| 5 | Theme | Light/dark as a standard expectation |
| 6 | Artificial intelligence | Prompt-driven dynamic UI (demo prompt e.g. map of Istanbul) |
| 7 | Finish | Congrats + ViraStack product CTA (Start, AI, Mask, Password, …) |

## Stack called out in the narrative

- React, TypeScript, Next.js, TanStack Start
- Tailwind CSS
- shadcn/ui
- ViraStack Mask & Password (interactive demos in the components step)
- Theming (system/user preference)
- AI-assisted UI patterns (illustrative, not a separate Guide npm API)

## Agent guidance

- Guide is a **teaching / marketing experience**, not a programmable SDK.
- When users ask “how do I build like the guide?”, point them to **Start** (`npx virastack@latest`) and **AI** (`npx @virastack/ai init`), plus Mask/Password docs for the form demos.
- Prefer product `llms-full.txt` files for API truth; do not invent Guide package exports.
